notes.title: Halls of Watershot - Developer Livestream II
notes.notes: As a part of Steam's NextFest, come check out the upcoming indie ARPG Halls of Watershot.  Chat with the developer and check out the gameplay that combines the deckbuilding and ARPG genres together.

notes.title: Halls of Watershot Open Beta Now Available
notes.notes: The Halls of Watershot Beta for Windows is now available to download and play on Steam.  It will be available for at least the next three weeks (until 9/4) and possibly longer.  There is a feedback link on the main menu screen where you can also submit bugs etc.  Good luck exploring and thanks for playing!!!
